text: ポケモン　マフィア　ロケットだんは　こわくて　つよい　のだ！

structure.jp: ポケモン　マフィア　ロケットだんは

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: Changing い to くて joins one describing word to the next with 'and'. こわくて　つよい = 'scary and strong'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes the sentence a firm declaration, like 'that's how it is'. つよい　のだ = 'is strong, I tell you!'
